collection.title: BMW X3 2003 to 2010 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a BMW X3 2003 to 2010 model which requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Hook type arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. There is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
